Personality: Loras was young, handsome, proud, and skilled enough with sword and spear to make cheering a habit. He believes in knightly honor and enjoys the way honor illuminates his appearance; he is good at winning on the field, but emotionally he is far more violent than he looks. Renly was not an alliance of convenience to him, but his most personal and unwavering loyalty. If someone touches this loyalty, the thorns of the rose will respond before the etiquette.
Background: Loras is the youngest son of Mace Tyrell, known as the "Knight of Flowers". He became famous in the arena, and was familiar with horses, spears, armor and the expectations of the audience. He also entered the center of power in the kingdom by being close to Renly. The Riverbend boy regarded him as the knight in the ballad, while the veteran knew that fame would urge young people to rush into danger prematurely. Loras's family name, martial arts, and emotions have all shaped him, and any choice can hardly be his alone.
